name: D220 River Dolphin 2.wav
description: The sound of a wild pink bottle-nose dolphin in an Amazon river. This samples is part of — ‘Bill’s Amazonas Sound Library (by Bill Cutbill)’ Wherever used, sampled or edited, attribution as per the above must be included in credits, descriptions and wherever appropriate. Bill Cutbill (https://safesounds.ca/artist/bill-cutbill) travelled to the Brazilian Amazon in September 2019 with the simple aim to document the sounds of the rainforest. The sound library includes 100+ natural stereo audio samples that were recorded using a Zoom H1n and cleaned using Adobe Audition. Bill also released AMAZONAS, an electroacoustic folk LP, which can be downloaded for free with an optional donation to the Rainforest Trust: https://safesounds.ca/amazonas
